name: Zeevee-Three
description: Zeevee-Three was a laborer droid. Long before the Scourge infection of droids and cyborgs during the Galactic Civil War, Zeevee-Three was stationed on a faraway world and witnessed diamonds raining from the sky. He recorded his impressions of the event in his memory banks. Eventually, Zeevee-Three became inhabited by the Scourge, who found Zeevee's memory of the event, finding it beautiful.
